qap_tod_distance.qap_quote: within a half-mile walk distance of transit corridors
qap_tod_distance.note: The CHFA QAP transit-oriented (TOD) distance used for every half-mile figure on this site: the HNA panel's half-mile share, the market analysis TOD ring and check, the recommendation and the HNA exports. CHFA scores walking distance; this site measures straight-line distance (owner decision on #1961), so every half-mile result carries the disclosure js/transit-zone.js builds from method and qap_method. Kept beside zone_radius_miles so the two distances have one home; scripts/market/build_transit_zone_by_geography.py reads miles from here and refuses any method but straight_line. test/transit-zone.test.js holds miles, qap_method and qap_citation to qap_quote in the archived QAP text.

map_publisher: Colorado Office of Economic Development and International Trade (OEDIT)
note: Until OEDIT publishes its Transit and Housing Investment Zone map, every zone result on this site is a screen: within two miles of a transit stop in data/amenities/transit_stops_statewide_co.geojson. The act counts only transportation facilities OEDIT identifies on that map, so a stop-based result can overstate eligibility. When the map is published, set status to "published", commit the zones as GeoJSON polygons, and name that file in zones_file; js/transit-zone.js then reports the official designation beside the screen result.
